### Groq Custom Endpoint Configuration in librechat.yaml

Source: https://www.librechat.ai/docs/configuration/librechat_yaml/ai_endpoints/groq

Configure Groq as a custom endpoint in your `librechat.yaml` file, specifying the API key, base URL, and supported models.

```yaml
    - name: "groq"
      apiKey: "${GROQ_API_KEY}"
      baseURL: "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/"
      models:
        default: [
          "llama3-70b-8192",
          "llama3-8b-8192",
          "llama2-70b-4096",
          "mixtral-8x7b-32768",
          "gemma-7b-it",
          ]
        fetch: false
      titleConvo: true
      titleModel: "mixtral-8x7b-32768"
      modelDisplayLabel: "groq"
```

### Perplexity Custom Endpoint Configuration

Source: https://www.librechat.ai/docs/configuration/librechat_yaml/ai_endpoints/perplexity

Configure Perplexity as a custom endpoint in `librechat.yaml`, specifying models, base URL, and other parameters.

```yaml
- name: "Perplexity"
  apiKey: "${PERPLEXITY_API_KEY}"
  baseURL: "https://api.perplexity.ai/"
  models:
    default: [
      "sonar-deep-research",
      "sonar-reasoning-pro",
      "sonar-reasoning",
      "sonar-pro",
      "sonar",
      "r1-1776"
      ]

  titleConvo: true
  titleModel: "llama-3-sonar-small-32k-chat"
  summarize: false
  summaryModel: "llama-3-sonar-small-32k-chat"
  dropParams: ["stop", "frequency_penalty"]
  modelDisplayLabel: "Perplexity"
```

### LiteLLM Endpoint Configuration in librechat.yaml

Source: https://www.librechat.ai/docs/configuration/librechat_yaml/ai_endpoints/litellm

Configure LiteLLM as a custom endpoint by specifying its name, API key, base URL, and model settings in your `librechat.yaml` file. This setup allows LibreChat to connect to your LiteLLM proxy.

```yaml

    default: ["gpt-3.5-turbo"]
    fetch: true
  titleConvo: true
  titleModel: "gpt-3.5-turbo"
  summarize: false
  summaryModel: "gpt-3.5-turbo"
```

### Configure Bedrock Endpoint in librechat.yaml

Source: https://www.librechat.ai/docs/configuration/pre_configured_ai/bedrock_inference_profiles

Add the `bedrock` endpoint configuration to your `librechat.yaml` file. This includes specifying available models and mapping them to custom inference profile ARNs, which can be set via environment variables or direct ARNs. You can also configure available regions for cross-region inference.

```yaml
endpoints:
  bedrock:
    # List the models you want available in the UI
    models:
      - 'us.anthropic.claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219-v1:0'
      - 'us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0'
      - 'global.anthropic.claude-opus-4-5-20251101-v1:0'
    # Map model IDs to their custom inference profile ARNs
    inferenceProfiles:
      # Using environment variable (recommended for security)
      'us.anthropic.claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219-v1:0': '${BEDROCK_CLAUDE_37_PROFILE}'
      # Using direct ARN
      'us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0': 'arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-1:123456789012:application-inference-profile/abc123'
      # Another env variable example
      'global.anthropic.claude-opus-4-5-20251101-v1:0': '${BEDROCK_OPUS_45_PROFILE}'
    # Optional: Configure available regions for cross-region inference
    availableRegions:
      - 'us-east-1'
      - 'us-west-2'
```

### Configure Custom Endpoints in librechat.yaml

Source: https://www.librechat.ai/docs/quick_start/custom_endpoints

Example configuration for `librechat.yaml` showing how to set up custom endpoints for OpenRouter, Ollama, and an Anthropic-compatible gateway. Ensure API keys are managed securely, preferably using environment variables.

```yaml
version: 1.3.13
cache: true
endpoints:
  custom:
    - name: 'OpenRouter'
      apiKey: '${OPENROUTER_KEY}'
      baseURL: 'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1'
      models:
        default: ['meta-llama/llama-3-70b-instruct']
        fetch: true
      titleConvo: true
      titleModel: 'meta-llama/llama-3-70b-instruct'
      dropParams: ['stop']
      modelDisplayLabel: 'OpenRouter'
    - name: 'Ollama'
      apiKey: 'ollama'
      baseURL: 'http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1/'
      models:
        default: ['llama3:latest', 'command-r', 'mixtral', 'phi3']
        fetch: true
      titleConvo: true
      titleModel: 'current_model'
    - name: 'Claude-Compatible'
      provider: 'anthropic'
      apiKey: '${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}'
      baseURL: 'https://api.anthropic.com'
      headers:
        anthropic-version: '2023-06-01'
      models:
        default: ['claude-sonnet-4-5']
        fetch: false
      titleConvo: true
      titleModel: 'claude-sonnet-4-5'
```

### LibreChat Memory Configuration with Custom Endpoint

Source: https://www.librechat.ai/docs/configuration/librechat_yaml/object_structure/memory

This example shows how to configure LibreChat's memory feature to use a custom endpoint. It includes defining the custom endpoint with its name, API key, base URL, headers (with environment variable and placeholder resolution), and models, alongside the memory configuration that specifies the custom endpoint provider.

```yaml
endpoints:
    custom:
        - name: 'Custom Memory Endpoint'
           apiKey: 'dummy'
           baseURL: 'https://api.gateway.ai/v1'
           headers:
             x-gateway-api-key: '${GATEWAY_API_KEY}'
             x-gateway-virtual-key: '${GATEWAY_OPENAI_VIRTUAL_KEY}'
             X-User-Identifier: '{{LIBRECHAT_USER_EMAIL}}'
             X-Application-Identifier: 'LibreChat - Test'
             api-key: '${TEST_CUSTOM_API_KEY}'
           models:
             default:
               - 'gpt-4o-mini'
               - 'gpt-4o'
             fetch: false

memory:
  disabled: false
  tokenLimit: 3000
  maxInputTokens: 12000
  personalize: true
  messageWindowSize: 10
  agent:
    provider: 'Custom Memory Endpoint'
    model: 'gpt-4o-mini'
```

### Configure TrueFoundry Endpoint in librechat.yaml

### Configure Bedrock Endpoint in librechat.yaml

Source: https://www.librechat.ai/docs/configuration/pre_configured_ai/bedrock

Customize Bedrock endpoint settings in your `librechat.yaml` file. This includes specifying available regions, stream rate, title model, and guardrail configurations.

```yaml
endpoints:
  bedrock:
    availableRegions:
      - 'us-east-1'
      - 'us-west-2'
    streamRate: 35
    titleModel: 'anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0'
    guardrailConfig:
      guardrailIdentifier: 'abc123xyz'
      guardrailVersion: '1'
      trace: 'enabled'
      streamProcessingMode: 'sync'
```
